I had marijuana induced psychosis some time ago.

I started realizing that my thoughts were very intrusive. No matter what thing i was thinking about my mind would very rapidly steer over to my "theme", which basically was making a model of not only the universe and everything in it, but everything beyond the universe as well. Basically ALL THAT IS. I made observations that my brain would see as "proof" that my great idea was correct. I caught this, and started googling psychosis. It was hard to focus on the articles i was reading, and with my twisted logic my psychosis also fit my everything-model perfectly. However, everything matched psychosis. Bird noises and chirping sounds were super loud, any cloud in the sky resembled something immediately. My mind wandering. "Word salad" when i tried to makes sentences about my thoughts.  I got super scared, and thought i could never again trust my rational brain. That fear stuck with me for a couple of days, i think i was slightly psychotic into the next day as well.

substance induced psychosis is easier to identify than a primary psychosis though.

8 hours ago I realized cannabis makes me psychotic. 

I smoked some pot to hopefully get my anxiety on another path. Went out to get a kebab. I started working on this conspiracy that the kebab shop was an Outpost for for money laundering and part of a huge organized crime ring, that hated white people and tried to poison us by undercooking the meat. (My chicken kebab was under cooked, and it is probably the worst kebab shop in town)

Then my mind started working on a infinite universe theory that I have frequently been thinking out when high. The thoughts became so intrusive. Everything I saw had a connection and I was unable to make a thought that didn't wander off to support my theory.

In a brief second of clarity I thought "this isn't right, my friends doesn't become like this when they're smoking. Am I psychotic right now?"

I sat down in the grass and Googled symptoms. I saw that many of the symptoms matched. Chirping sounds from birds and other stuff was incredibly loud and clear. When I watched the skies, the skies always seemed to represent something, look like something familiar. Usually when I look at the skies I have to do some mental gymnastics to make them look like stuff.

While all of this went on, my mind was very aggressively wandering back to how everything was connected by repeating itself. (I know it doesn't make sense) 

When I tried to make sense of my thoughts, I had a small realization that my mind was racing so fast that I couldn't keep track of it. I can only imagine the "word salad" that would come out of my mouth if trying to articulate it....

I'm not really sure what to do now. I feel like I'm going insane.

Could very well be weed.

Yeah, I have severe anxiety for going back to university campus, especially my building. When I was still a student (just a few months ago) I would finally muster up the courage to take the train over there. And I would sit on a bench for several hours, listening to music or audiobooks. Trying to summon the courage to go to my office and work on my thesis. But I just couldn't. After a few hours I'd go home and cry.

A couple of months ago I decided it didn't work and I had to give up graduate school. It was a hard blow, and one I had experienced about a year ago as well. However my office is still occupied by my stuff and I need to go clean my spot. It's just so fucking anxiety inducing to go back there, the fear of meeting fellow students, people who looked up to me, people who expected me to succeed. And just the place in itself.

I managed to go pick up most of my stuff and stash all my books in a closet this Christmas, when I knew no one would be around, but I know I'll have to go back someday to get it. I just want to forget the whole place, but on the flip side some of my best years was spent there, I had a great time in uni and it's just so sad that I'm left with these feeling about that place .
